note: The world-continuity gate's ratchet (docs/qa/world-continuity-gate.md). Every metric was measured at 544f67c (integrate/wave1) by the suites in tests/golden/world/ and the gate's e2e specs. A PR may not make a metric worse; one that improves it lowers its baseline (pnpm world:baseline). A defect marked fixed makes every metric that tracks only fixed defects a hard assertion at its target. Statuses are edited by hand, in the PR that fixes the defect.

L-01.title: 23 duplicate and 24 coplanar-roof footprint pairs z-fight.

L-02.title: Wall bottoms float 5 to 25 cm above the drawn ground on 38 buildings.

L-03.title: Two buildings straddle the south edge and hang over the void: 201006.0017547 by 118.6 m (37.705434,-122.462201) and 0008708 by 16.4 m (37.705490,-122.416322).
L-03.note: QA at 54ee728: open (now behind the wall; visual only)

L-04.title: The saints-peter-and-paul probe in `pipeline/areas.json` points 143 m away, at 201006.0003946. The church is 201006.0001265 and its -tower. (Coit is in W-27.)

L-05.title: If a tile GLB fails, the collider fallback extrudes from baseY - 1 m: 51,328 hillside buildings would float, 5,172 of them by more than 3 m.
L-05.note: QA at 54ee728: partly (head retries a failed GLB once after 1.5 s; the fallback is unchanged)

L-06.title: The DEM is requested at about 4 x 5 m although USGS serves 1 m. With the 10 m lattice, cliffs, cuts and retaining walls are rounded off by up to 6.6 m (lattice) and 9.3 m (request).

L-07.title: 2 to 4 m notches in road ribbons at sharp polyline bends.

L-08.title: Alcatraz exists only as far terrain, flattened by 9 to 13 m, with no buildings.

L-09.title: 10.1% of the sidewalk graph (3,560 edges) lies inside footprints. No runtime code reads `sidewalks.json` yet.

L-10.title: Boulevards are drawn narrower than their corridors; alley and residential kerbs run into buildings.

L-11.title: 9 ribbon seams open by more than 2 cm (max 0.27 m at t-5_5/t-5_6); 4 junction caps are unmatched across seams.

L-12.title: Treasure Island and YBI are unreachable by road (wave 8). There are 26 components, 7 one-way sinks, and one-way edges that dead-end at the county line.

L-13.title: About 1 ha of sim land is drawn as water (Mission Creek shoreline, t0_4). The 10 m staircase is in W-35.

L-14.title: 48% of 1,641,534 corners split a window; 21,321 window rows are sliced by the roofline; 29,524 ground-floor windows are clipped at the 0.8 m mask.

L-15.title: 485 low-rise houses carry a box centred on the roof, rising 3 to 12 m.
L-15.note: QA at 54ee728: open (not recounted at head, where the condo rule added 64 tower records)
